note: Fresh nationwide batch using audit-driven Solution A standards: surgical, high-fidelity homepage cleanup prototypes tied to concrete audit findings. Parent and workers targeted gpt-5.5.

items.name: JR Contracting & Handyman Services LLC
items.summary: Wix handyman site has generic template copy, weak service hierarchy, and a vague contact path despite clear Vancouver WA local-service intent.

items.name: TOMY’S Mobile Detailing
items.summary: Utah mobile detailing page has real packages and contact info but suffers from cramped service copy, weak trust proof, and no clear booking flow.

items.name: Wraggs Welding Repair
items.summary: Welding repair site has a recognizable solo-tradesperson feel, but template-like headings, broad claims, and buried service proof leave a strong cleanup opportunity.

items.name: Houston Personal Concierge
items.summary: Service list is extensive but overwhelming; a buyer-intent homepage can make errand, executive, realtor, travel, and home-management paths clearer.

items.name: LQC Marketing Consulting
items.summary: Consulting site has credible experience but dense copy, repeated marketing categories, and a weak conversion path for project inquiries.

items.name: PNW Mobile Detailing
items.summary: Mobile detailing site has seasonal offer residue, sparse service clarity, and minimal trust framing despite clear phone/email lead intent.

items.name: On The Level Handyman LLC
items.summary: WV handyman site has licensing credibility and estimate intent but generic Wix blocks, thin trust proof, and unclear service grouping.

items.name: L & M Contracting, LLC
items.summary: Michigan site-work contractor has a useful service list and contact info but needs a clearer quote path, service buckets, and commercial/residential trust cues.

items.name: Catalan Tree & Landscaping Service
items.summary: Tree and landscaping site shows placeholder testimonials and scattered service copy, making trust cleanup and quote-flow clarity easy to demonstrate.

items.name: JW Home Improvements and Landscape LLC
items.summary: Madison home improvement/landscape site has clear local intent but template testimonials, thin differentiation, and service paths that need tightening.
